description: This Java class implements a custom ServiceDiscovery mechanism for Docker Swarm environments in an Akka-based application. It handles DNS resolution without caching to facilitate bootstrapping in dynamic Docker Swarm clusters, resolving service names to IP addresses and handling timeouts.

classes.name: DockerSwarmServiceDiscovery
classes.description: A custom ServiceDiscovery implementation for resolving services within a Docker Swarm environment, with specific handling of DNS TTL and resolution timeouts.

methods.name: DockerSwarmServiceDiscovery
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service discovery with an ActorSystem.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs a service lookup asynchronously, resolving service names to IP addresses with a timeout.

methods.name: resolveService
methods.description: Resolves a service name to a list of IP addresses, returning a Future with the results.

methods.name: scheduleTimeout
methods.description: Schedules a timeout for the DNS lookup operation, returning a failed Future if resolution takes too long.
